Compare the similar manuscript map: "A plan of the Forts Montgomery & Clinton as taken by His Majesty's forces under the command of Genl. Sr. Henry Clinton the 6th. of Octr. 1777" held by the Library of Congress (Call Number G3804.F5865 1777 .H6)
Compare a similar map of forts Montgomery and Clinton, number 14.029a (fiche 497/1), in the King's Military Collection at the Royal Library, Windsor?

Copy at Add Ms 27,715.7. Manuscript "7" added in pencil at upper right and "168" (crossed through) at lower centre. Shows a yellow circular label "MC" at lower centre. Manuscript addition in ink at upper right shows "Presented Colonel Augustus Frazer K.C.B. R.A.". Laid on archival tissue. Green circular label to verso showing "23". White label to verso showing "DRAWER 30 SECTION 1". Blue label to verso showing "A 30/49". Additional labels show "190". Manuscript annotations to verso in ink show "Plan of Forts Montgomery & Clinton".
